seo_description: EdgeDesk prices Tennessee Titans at Baltimore Ravens at Baltimore Ravens -10.8 with a 45.9 fair total. Baltimore Ravens wins 84% of simulations. Model status AGREEMENT. Research, not picks.

lede: Baltimore Ravens carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Baltimore Ravens -10.8 with a fair total of 45.9, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Baltimore Ravens pass offence vs Tennessee Titans pass defence, which sits +0.218 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
